nodes.text:
Legate of nothing, commander of no one. The title outlived the office and I've not had the heart to drop it.

But I still know what needs doing, and you look like someone who does things.

I held the Throne's ledger. Every legion, every ordinal, every soul the Kiln spent and what it bought.

It balances. That's what I can't put down. Everything the Kiln burned, it burned for a reason, and the reasons are all written in my hand, and they were all good reasons, and here we are.

What the Kiln was for. Its own words, not mine.

Everything else here - the choir, the throne, the ordinals, the whole burning apparatus - is scaffolding around one fire that was lit on purpose. Nobody living knows what for. Muren of forty years ago thought he did.
